name: Radiant Aura
description: Aura. Allies in range deal [spell modifier] bonus light damage on attack rolls. At higher levels: +[spell modifier / 2] bonus damage.

name: Precision Aura
description: Aura. Allies in range gain +1 to attack rolls. Each miss increases bonus by +1, resets to +1 after a hit.

name: Curing Touch
description: Heal an ally for [spell modifier + 11 + 2d10] and end one minor non-magical disease or poison/poisoned effect.

name: Crushing Light
description: Strike the ground, charging a 5 ft wide, 10 ft long line with divine energy. Erupts at start of next turn dealing [2x spell modifier + 24 + 3d12] light damage.

name: Light's Blessing
description: First saving throw against a negative condition/penalty is rolled with advantage. At higher levels: -1 AP cost.

name: Divine Senses
description: Add [spell modifier] to all insight, perception and investigation checks. Passive scores also increase by [spell modifier].

name: Stone Hammer
description: Ranged spell attack dealing [spell mod + 13 + 4d6] crushing damage and [spell mod + 13 + 4d6] light damage. Both reduced by armor.

name: Focused Faith
description: Gain [spell modifier + 25 + 2d10] temporary HP. While shield persists, cannot heal others. Disadvantage on two-handed/off-hand weapon attacks.

name: Swarm-Killer Aura
description: Aura. Allies in range are not affected by flanks/pack-tactics. Attacks against them cannot have advantage.

name: Legion Aura
description: Aura. Allies in range have advantage on attack rolls on enemies if they and another ally are within melee range of a foe.

name: Holy Weapon
description: Weapon shines bright/dim light (sunlight). Attacked creatures must CON save or be blinded for 1 turn.

name: Smite of Wrath
description: Ranged spell attack. On hit: [2x spell modifier + 32 + 4d10] lightning damage and target loses one random damage resistance until start of next turn.

name: Smite of Force
description: Ranged spell attack. On hit: [2x spell modifier + 35 + 4d8] force damage and target is pushed 15 ft.

name: Healing Orbs
description: Create 3 orbs. Each heals a creature in melee range for [2x spell modifier + 2d8]. Activate any time, no AP cost. Cannot heal self.

name: Radiant Fury
description: Prepare for next attack. If hit by weapon attack, absorb damage and become enraged until end of next turn, dealing double damage. CC ends the effect.

name: Radiant Explosion
description: AoE explosion of radiant energy. All enemies in 15 ft must CON save or take [2x spell modifier + 27 + 3d8] light damage and be knocked prone.

name: Hammer of Justice
description: Throw weapon at target (ranged weapon attack). On hit: weapon damage + teleport to target. On miss: weapon travels to range, can teleport to it or recall.

name: Vampiric Aura
description: Aura. Allies in range heal for 20% of damage dealt with single target attacks and spells.

name: Predator Aura
description: Aura. Allies in range score critical hits when hitting a stunned or prone enemy.

name: Dual Arc
description: Split into 2 bolts of light dashing 30 ft creating a circle. One deals [3x spell mod + 25 + 3d8] light damage, the other heals for the same. Free basic attack at destination.

name: Gaze of the Gods
description: Summon god's gaze on 5 ft radius area. All creatures must WILL save or be petrified for the duration. Repeat save at end of each turn.

name: Searing Smite
description: On weapon attack, target takes [3x spell modifier + 3d6] bonus fire damage and takes double damage from all smites until end of next turn.

name: Divine Shield
description: Gain temporary HP equal to half max HP until end of next turn. Immune to all CC during this time. At higher levels: -1 AP cost.

name: Transposition Smite
description: Melee spell attack. On hit: [3x spell modifier + 23 + 6d4] force damage and target is teleported to a point within range.

name: Godly Mend
description: Heal an ally for [3x spell modifier + 10 + 3d10] and end all petrified, stunned, rooted, snared, paralysis, immobilised effects.

name: Fearless Aura
description: Aura. Allies in range are immune to terrified. When an attempt to terrify them is made, they become enraged for 1 turn, dealing max dice damage.

name: Purity Aura
description: Aura. Allies in range are resistant to light damage and immune to possession/enthrallment. No effect on already possessed/enthralled creatures.

name: Smite of Oblivion
description: Smite alongside weapon attack. Target takes [4x spell modifier + 4d10] light damage. Max once per turn.

name: Godly Oasis
description: Teleport self and up to [spell modifier] creatures to a safe god-created oasis for rest. Duration reduced to 30 min if cast in combat. Return to exact spot.

name: Silence the Heretics
description: Choose a creature secretly. First time any creature tries casting a verbal spell on the target, the attacker is silenced for the duration. Half duration if attacker's might >= your level.

name: Mountain Hammer
description: Up to 5 ranged spell attacks against different foes. Each deals [4x spell mod + 50 + 4d12] crushing AND [4x spell mod + 50 + 4d12] light damage. Both reduced by armor.

name: Banishing Smite
description: Melee spell attack. On hit: [4x spell modifier + 8d10] pure damage. Target must WILL save or be banished to god's prison for the duration.

name: Divine Favour
description: Teleport self and up to [spell modifier] allies 100 ft in one direction. Alternatively, channel 2 turns to teleport to nearest church of your god.

name: Grounded Aura
description: Aura. Allies in range are immune to teleportation, banishing and insta-kill effects.

name: Blessed Aura
description: Aura. Allies in range roll d100 each time they take damage. On 85 or more, they take no damage.

name: Divine Wrath
description: Target must WILL save, taking [5x spell modifier + 245 + 10d12] true damage on fail, or half on success.

name: Ultimate Fate
description: Channel a 60 ft long, 10 ft wide beam of fire and light. Each turn damages enemies and heals allies for [5x spell modifier + 5d12] per AP consumed. 1 AP to redirect 90 degrees.

name: Sacred Bolt
description: Ranged spell attack dealing [spell modifier + 11 + 2d8] light damage. Recastable same turn.

name: Healing Word
description: Heal an ally within range for [spell modifier + 4 + 2d6]. Recastable same turn at double mana each subsequent cast.

name: Shaming Word
description: Target must WILL save or cannot look at you until start of next turn, giving disadvantage on attacks against you. Recastable on different targets.

name: Back from the Edge
description: Restore an unconscious creature within range to 1 HP without Medicine check. Placed last in initiative. Unavailable if campaign uses instant death.

name: Healing Touch / Withering Touch
description: Healing: heal ally in melee for [spell mod + 12 + 3d10]. Necrotic: melee spell attack dealing [spell mod + 12 + 3d10] shadow damage.

name: Energy Sacrifice
description: Grant a creature within range 2 additional AP at the start of its next turn.

name: Divine Chastise
description: Apply 1 weakened stack to a creature. Double stacks if you are severely injured. Scaling: +1 weakened stack per level.

name: Illuminate / Eclipse
description: Illuminate: create 15 ft radius sphere of light. Eclipse: create 15 ft radius sphere of darkness. Can be placed on an object to follow it.

name: Cleansed Vision
description: End blinded on a creature. For duration, creature gains 30 ft darkvision.

name: Lingering Light / Lingering Darkness
description: Light: WILL save or [2x spell mod + 39 + 4d8] light damage, emits bright light 20 ft, auto-fails stealth. Darkness: heal [2x spell mod + 39 + 4d8], emits darkness 20 ft, advantage on stealth.

name: Godly Expertise
description: Reaction. On Knowledge, Arcana, or Religion check to identify holy/unholy objects, blessings/curses, or removal methods: add [5x spell modifier] to the roll.

name: Holy Revitalise / Darkened Ruin
description: Revitalise: heal [2x spell mod + 22 + 4d6] and remove 1 burning/envenomed/bleeding/wounded. Ruin: CON save or [2x spell mod + 22 + 4d6] fire/poison damage + burning/envenomed effect.

name: Healing Invocation
description: Heal all allies in range for [4x spell mod + 32 + 8d10]. In combat, can channel up to 3 rounds; healing doubles each turn of channeling.

name: Light Ward
description: Ward a creature against harmful magic. Advantage on saving throws and spell attacks against it have disadvantage until start of your next turn.

name: Peaceful Retaliation
description: First weapon attack against chosen creature gives attacker 2 disarmed stacks. Can be used as reaction for half stacks. Scaling: +1 disarmed stack.

name: Worthy Requite
description: Whenever you heal a creature, gain temporary HP equal to half the amount healed until start of next turn. Existing temp HP persists even if concentration breaks.

name: Prayer of Silence
description: Channel. At end of each turn, all enemies in range that can hear you must WILL save or gain 3 silenced stacks. Scaling: +1 silenced stack.

name: Illuminating Descent
description: Choose a point. Holy light descends in 10 ft radius. DEX save or take [2x spell mod + 27 + 4d12] light damage.

name: Healing Rays
description: Fire up to 3 healing rays. Each heals all creatures within 5 ft of impact for [3x spell mod + 39 + 9d6]. Each creature healed by only one ray.

name: Fountain of Renewal
description: After channeling for duration, create a fountain lasting 1 day. 5 uses, 1 AP to drink, restores 10% max HP. Max 120 total HP restored. Scaling: +45 total HP.

name: Repentance / Subjugation
description: Repentance: CHA save or [3x spell mod + 17 + 5d8] light damage. Allies within 5 ft of target heal [3x spell mod + 5d8] per turn. Subjugation: shadow variant damages nearby enemies.

name: Radiant Nova / Umbral Nova
description: Radiant: WIS save or [3x spell mod + 42 + 6d12] light damage; heal for half total damage. Umbral: shadow variant; can sacrifice HP for bonus damage to all who failed.

name: Holy Aid
description: End prone, rooted, and snared on a creature. Heal for [3x spell mod + 5 + 6d4].

name: Domain of Tranquility
description: Create a 30 ft radius area centered on you. All creatures within are considered weakened. Does not modify existing weakened stacks. Double AP to center on a point within 30 ft.

name: Brand of the Infidels
description: CON save or [6x spell mod + 83 + 10d10] fire damage + 5 decaying stacks. Can forgo fire damage for half AP cost.

name: Forced Mediation
description: Two creatures cannot damage each other. Each unwilling creature may WILL save; if any succeeds, spell has no effect. Scaling: +2 to spell save DC.

name: Enfeeble
description: Ranged spell attack. On hit: [3x spell mod + 40 + 3d8] psychic damage + 3 corroded stacks. Recastable same turn. Scaling: +1 corroded stack.

name: Divine Premonition
description: Name an objective and a specific action. Make a Religion check (DC 50 baseline). On success, receive divine intuition whether the action would aid, hinder, or have no impact.

name: Eyes of the Judge
description: Create a 20 ft tall statue of your god. Enemies in its 30 ft cone that damage you or allies must WILL save or be frightened until end of their turn.

name: Holy Cross / Scorching Cross
description: Create a cross shape on the ground. Healing: creatures at 4 ends healed for [4x spell mod + 27 + 4d6], center creature healed for additional amount. Scorching: fire damage variant [4x spell mod + 37 + 4d6].

name: Altar of Silence
description: Create a 30 ft radius sphere where no creature can talk, disabling all verbal component spells.

name: Refreshing Wave
description: 60 degree, 90 ft cone. Heals all allies for [4x spell mod + 37 + 4d8] and removes burning and poisoned.

name: Cleansing Spark
description: Heal ally for [4x spell mod + 4d10] and end one of: terrified, stunned, incapacitated, paralysed, petrified, crystallised.

name: Sanctuary
description: Create a 20 ft radius sphere of peace. No creature in area can take/deal damage or be targeted by negative effects. Channel/concentration can still be broken.

name: Divine Spark
description: Ranged spell attack. On hit: [4x spell mod + 90 + 10d12] light/shadow damage.

name: Bells of the Church
description: Enemies that hear: CON save or [5x spell mod + 60 + 10d6] thunder damage + prone, half on success. Allies that hear: healed for same amount + end prone.

name: Shield of Faith
description: Give creature 250 temporary HP. Immune to CC while shield persists. If shield depleted before duration, creature takes double damage for 1 round. Max once per creature per fight.

name: Divine Teleportation
description: Teleport to another point within range.

name: Decadent Souls
description: Target must WIS save or become decaying, being damaged by healing for the duration.

name: Divine Light / Divine Chaos
description: Light: 90 ft cube, dissipates winds/clouds/darkness (unless from higher level spell). Chaos: 90 ft cube, creates wind/cloud/mist/darkness.

name: Messenger of God
description: Up to 100 creatures must WIS save or believe you are the true messenger of your god. Unaware of magic after spell ends. Only affects creatures capable of believing in gods.

name: Revive
description: After 1 round of channeling, revive a creature dead less than 1 week. Does not regenerate limbs or cure effects at time of death. Respawns with 6 fatigue stacks and 1 HP.

name: Plane Travel
description: After 1 hour of channeling, teleport self and up to [spell modifier] creatures to another plane of existence. Must know the plane's name. 1 day cooldown.

name: Divine Glyph
description: Place a glyph on an object/wall. Protected against spells lvl 6 and lower and physical harm. When triggered: [12x spell mod + 200 + 24d10] damage + CON save or blinded 1 min.

name: Holy Protection / Unholy Protection
description: 1 hour ritual to protect a building. Unholy/holy creatures must CHA save to enter. On success: disadvantage on all rolls, outline glows yellow.

name: Holy Shelter
description: Protect a creature. Any attacker must WILL save or their ability fails (AP and mana still consumed).

name: Holy Relic / Destruction Ward
description: Relic: heals allies within 30 ft for [3x spell mod + 18 + 3d6] per round. Ward: damages enemies within 30 ft for same (shadow, ignores armor). 150 HP, 18 AC. Scaling: +25 HP, +2 AC.

name: Healing Tides
description: Heal all allies in range for [7x spell mod + 110 + 14d10] and end 1 negative effect per ally (your choice).

name: Complete Restoration
description: Heal creature to full HP, remove all negative effects, recover all lost limbs/body parts. Once per combat.

name: Divine Blast
description: Ranged spell attack. On hit: [7x spell mod + 85 + 7d12] light/shadow damage. Religion check DC 23 for bonus 200 true damage (god sends mission before reuse).

name: Divine Judgement
description: All enemies in range must WILL save or take [7x spell mod + 7d4] light damage and be stunned for 3 turns. Half damage on success. 24hr immunity after saving/enduring.

name: Aid of the Divine
description: Choose up to [spell modifier] creatures. All rolls of 10 and below are rerolled. Cannot be possessed, frightened or cursed/blessed.

name: Tranquillity
description: Healing rain falls from the sky. Restore up to 1000 HP split as you like among allies.

name: True Resurrection
description: Revive a creature dead up to 1 millennium. New body, all curses/illnesses removed. Religion check for >1000 years (DC 20 + 1 per century over). Full HP/resources. One attempt per creature ever.

name: Land of Angels / Land of Devils
description: Teleport self and up to [spell modifier] creatures to your god's domain for the duration. God will not reject you but may ignore you.

name: Lightshot
description: Ranged spell attack against first target in path. On hit: [spell mod + 7 + 2d6] light damage.

name: Echoed Healing
description: Heal ally for [spell mod + 6 + 2d6]. If ally not full HP, recastable on same ally same turn (mana only on first cast).

name: Shield of Shade
description: Give creature [spell mod + 16 + 2d10] magic shield. While shield stands, creature resists shadow and light damage (only if previously normal against them).

name: Radiant Flame
description: 10 ft radius sphere of light from the sky. DEX save or [spell mod + 7 + 2d10] fire damage.

name: Spear of Illumination
description: Channel 2 turns. STR save or [spell mod + 17 + 4d12] light damage and pushed 1d4 x 10 ft. Half damage on success, no push.

name: Chains of Light
description: CHA save or rooted for duration. Only affects shadow realm creatures. CON save to end. At higher levels: can target any creature.

name: Radiant Trap
description: Place invisible glyph. When creature enters 5 ft: [spell mod + 1d10] damage and blinded for duration (CON save to end). Glyph lasts 3 turns.

name: Summon Light Swallow
description: Summon a light bird. Telepathic communication within 100 ft. Can only move/fly. AC 10, 1 HP. If killed, you take 2d10 true damage.

name: Force Blast
description: 10 ft radius blast. All creatures (except you) must STR save or take [2x spell mod + 24 + 2d8] force damage and be pushed 15 ft.

name: Armor of the Pure
description: First weapon attack that hits the protected creature deals no damage. If attacker is unholy, it must CON save or be stunned until end of next turn.

name: Radiant Ray
description: 90 ft long, 10 ft wide line of light. DEX save or [2x spell mod + 21 + 2d10] light damage, half on success.

name: Streak of Light
description: Ranged spell attack. On hit: [2x spell mod + 5 + 2d10] light damage. Repeatable this turn with no mana cost.

name: Radiant Flux
description: WILL save or creature is covered in bright aura. If you deal light damage to it this turn, it takes [2x spell mod + 51 + 6d12] additional light damage.

name: Prison of the Damned
description: 10 ft radius sphere. Creatures inside must STR save (2 AP, once per turn) to leave.

name: Chain Healing
description: Heal target for [3x spell mod + 28 + 3d6]. Bounces to another ally in range of last target. Max 5 bounces, no repeats.

name: Twin Lights
description: Two reflecting light rays. Different targets: ranged spell attack each for [3x spell mod + 20 + 3d10] light/fire. Same target: DEX save or [3x spell mod + 48 + 3d10] combined.

name: Force Field
description: STR save or push creature with magical force. If hits wall, can channel to keep snared (disadvantage on repeat saves). Can cast exorcism spells while channeling. Large or smaller only.

name: Teleporting Trinity
description: Target 3 creatures (2 must be 20+ ft apart). Switch all creatures/objects in the three 10 ft radius areas cyclically (1->2, 2->3, 3->1).

name: Holy Liturgy
description: All enemies in range that hear must CHA save or take [3x spell mod + 25 + 3d6] light damage. Double damage against unholy beings.

name: Divine Prison
description: Create a 90 ft long, 10 ft wide line of light. At end of next turn, creatures on it are lifted 30 ft in spheres of light, incapacitated. WILL save each turn to end. Max 10 ft wide creatures.

name: Scorching Sins
description: Create up to 40 ft radius glowing coal surface. Creatures starting turn in area take [3x spell mod + 4d4] fire damage. Extra damage per AP of movement. Triple damage for unholy. Reduced by armor.

name: Shaped Evil
description: Force invisible creature's outline to glow. Pull creature from shadow/spectral plane (CHA save). Speaking true name auto-fails save for shadow/spectral plane; allows pulling from any plane with save.

name: Purging Cross
description: Cross shape on ground. Creatures at ends: WILL save or [4x spell mod + 32 + 4d6] light damage. Center creature takes bonus. If all ends had creatures, center is stunned 1 min (no saves for 2 turns).

name: Holy Steed
description: Spectral steed charges in 90 ft x 10 ft line. CON save or [4x spell mod + 31 + 4d10] spectral damage + prone, half on success. Can channel for 7 steeds (70 ft wide), double damage.

name: Towards the Light
description: Spawn light essence. Creatures within 30 ft starting turn must WILL save or consume 1d4 AP walking toward it. Attacks of opportunity auto-miss affected creatures.

name: Crucifix of Protection
description: Protect 15 ft diameter sphere around you (stationary). No magic damage can be received/dealt except light or true damage.

name: Sky Strikes
description: 10 ft radius light beam from sky. DEX save or [4x spell mod + 6 + 4d8] light damage. Two more free strikes (same spot same turn, or separate spots before end of next turn).

name: Healing Star
description: 8 healing beams in star pattern, each 15 ft. Heal first creature hit for [4x spell mod + 4d6]. If X+ beams hit, recastable free (X starts at 1, increases). Does not heal self.

name: Let There Be Light
description: Cover 10 ft sphere in divine light until end of turn. All creatures take double light damage. At end of turn, covered creatures become immune to light damage until end of next turn.

name: Light Tower
description: Create a 150 ft tall magical lighthouse. Light dispels fog/darkness/clouds from equal or lower level spells. Unholy beings in light: halved movement, no plane teleport, half damage.

name: Soul Transfer
description: CHA save. On fail: [5x spell mod + 10 + 5d12] pure damage; heal an ally for same amount. On success: half damage, half healing.

name: Fate Edict
description: CHA save or target takes no damage/healing for 2 turns. At end, all accumulated damage is multiplied by 1.5x and all healing is doubled. One target at a time.

name: Dazing Beam
description: 15 ft radius sphere. CON save or [5x spell mod + 24 + 5d10] light damage + prone (stunned if in center). Half damage on success.

name: Divine's Wrath
description: Channel. Each turn make ranged spell attacks equal to half AP consumed. Each hit: [5x spell mod + 37 + 5d8] spectral damage + push 10 ft.

name: Channeled Light
description: Channel 2 turns. 90 ft x 10 ft beam deals [28x spell mod + 400 + 28d10] light damage. If target dies, heal 20% max HP and recover mana cost. Direction chosen at cast.

name: Final Rest
description: Create a singing spectral maiden of light. Creatures starting turn within 30 ft must WILL save or fall asleep for 1 turn. Save also required on cast.

name: Shield of Divinity
description: Create a floating 5 ft radius spectral shield. Blocks all projectiles/spells except light damage. Light damage spells passing through gain double range, AoE, and damage.

name: Impenetrable Light
description: 5 ft radius light shield. Deflects ranged weapons, melee attackers take [6x spell mod] light damage. Creatures adjacent at turn start/end take same. Can absorb 350 damage. Scaling: +50 absorb, +spell mod damage.

name: Piercing Light
description: Ranged spell attack. On hit: [6x spell mod + 60 + 12d12] light or piercing damage (your choice). Ignores target's armor.

name: Sense Doom
description: Sense any unholy curse, affliction or possession on a creature/spell, and identify which overlord/archcreature it belongs to. Greater unholy creatures can stealth check to block.

name: Sacrifice of the Fallen
description: Force unholy being out of a possessed creature. WILL save or the creature dies; the being takes true damage equal to the creature's HP at death. 24hr immunity on success.

name: Sorrow of the Sinners
description: Channel. Each hostile creature in range must WILL save before casting a spell or attacking. On fail, AP and mana consumed but action does not happen.

name: Holy Rain
description: Channel. Each turn, [AP consumed] drops land at chosen points. Healing drops heal 5 ft area for [7x spell mod + 7d6]. Scorching drops deal same as fire damage (pierces armor).

name: Cross of the Divided
description: X-shaped cross, 120 ft lines, 4 quadrants (60 ft squares). Each area has a different effect: heal, light damage (CON save), blind+slow, or silence (CON save). Areas rotate clockwise each turn.

name: Banished Horrors
description: Banish an unholy being. If it has 250 HP or less, it instantly dies. If might >= exorcist level, WILL save to avoid.

name: The Holy Spirit
description: Giant bird of light dives in 200 ft x 50 ft line. DEX save or [16x spell mod + 216 + 16d10] light damage, half on success.

name: Divine Blast
description: Ranged spell attack with spectral appearance of your god. On hit: [16x spell mod + 350 + 16d12] light damage. Double and true damage against unholy beings.

name: Beacon of Hope
description: Become crystallized and channel. Each turn all allies heal for 50% max HP, and any single-round damage exceeding 80% max HP is nullified.
